text:
anya: FYI — Nexus granted us "lab passports" for a limited marketplace preview. NDA signed yesterday. They want a concise bench + telemetry run this cycle. tagging @miguel @kevin for perf plan and @linda for marketplace packaging. Need initial plan by EOD tomorrow.

miguel: ack. who is Nexus POC and what are the access windows? also any constraints on firmware/kernel versions?

anya: POC is jess@nx.com (we'll email from partnerships alias). lab hours M-F 08:00-18:00 PT, 4 concurrent slot tokens. they asked for kernel tags: nx-kernel-2026-05 or later.

kevin: I'll own bench execution. propose three configs: fp16 baseline, int8-ptq, int8-qat. target p50 < 80ms on 2K seq; throughput target 300 tok/s sustained. I'll open a PR with the bench script.

kevin: bench command i'll use (local runner):

```
./run_bench.sh --model redwood-xl-1b --seq 2048 --backend nx-runtime --profile int8-ptq --concurrency 4 --out results.json
```

miguel: looks good. add KV-cache warmup step (run 3 short prefixes) and measure cold vs warm p90. we'll need to capture per-token breakdown.

linda: Marketplace requirements: artifact (docker image + sha256), model-card (privacy + safety), size/ram hints, and a short how-to for lab ops. also need a contact for KMS policy review — @samir can you confirm KMS constraints for Nexus-hosted test images?

samir: short answer: allowed if encryption-at-rest is enabled and we have a cross-account read-only KMS grant. we'll need an ISA/attestation doc from Nexus for HSM-backed keys. I'll list required fields and send to legal.

anya: helpful — thanks. Also Nexus wants a short telemetry hook (HTTP POST) for perf and health only, not payload content. we should provide a lightweight endpoint and opt-in flag.

kevin: implementing a metrics sink is trivial. propose schema: {"run_id","slot","p50","p90","errors","cpu","gpu_util"}. we'll send example: 

```json
{"run_id":"nx-2026-05-03-001","slot":2,"p50":72.4,"p90":132.1,"errors":0,"gpu_util":78}
```

miguel: make sure timestamps are ISO and include seq-length. we also need to capture model weights checksum to validate we ran the right binary.

linda: packaging note — marketplace listing needs a short blurb and logo approval 48h before any joint announcement. we shouldn't mention results publicly until both parties sign off.

anya: agreed. legal will gate announcement copy. We'll do two-phase: EAP internal results -> partner review -> controlled announcement.

ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: Nexus EAP kickoff — Thu 2026-05-06 16:00 PT (30m). Invite sent to @miguel, @kevin, @linda, @samir, partnerships alias.

kevin: i'll prepare bench PR and an initial results dashboard. ETA for PR: tomorrow 11:00 PT.

miguel: i'll prepare the telemetry spec and a short runbook for lab ops.

linda: i'll draft marketplace artifact checklist and the model-card template.

samir: i'll draft KMS ask and the minimal attestation checklist for Nexus.

anya: perfect. small checklist I captured: 1) bench PR + scripts, 2) telemetry endpoint + schema, 3) marketplace artifact + model-card, 4) KMS/attestation, 5) legal NDA review for announcement, 6) schedule slots in lab. I'll track in the partnerships board.

kevin: one more ops note — plan to capture power/thermal logs if Nexus allows; that helps on quantization anomalies. will ask during kickoff.

anya: great. thanks everyone. i'll loop legal and confirm POC contact info in the thread after the email goes out. :thumbsup: :eyes:

linda: :thumbsup: will prep the listing template.
